effects.description: (2 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) When you deal damage with a weapon, you spawn a volcano that erupts after |cffffff1|r second, launching liquid hot lava at the closest enemy dealing 1860 Flame damage. This effect can occur once every |cffffff8|r seconds and scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.
